statement: Active support is a finite subset of the support set computed from payload, certificate/status, motif, frontier/shell/tail, and family-chain fields.
Restricting the witness to active support defines an output object when all required fields are contained in active support.
The restricted output can be renormalized into the selected support normal form.
If active support is a strict subset, support_size decreases and the lexicographic support tuple strictly decreases.
If active support equals the full support set, projection is no-op and does not create a smaller witness.
Projection preserves/refines payload relation when all payload coordinates are active.
Projection preserves counterexample status, reduces to smaller witness, or names blocker/escape under the project-to-active status skeleton.
Projecting to active support and then canonicalizing agrees with canonicalizing then projecting the active coordinate image.
Recognized family-chain source form remains recognized after projection when all recognizer/lift fields are active.
Projection failure is named as no-op, payload/status blocker, family-chain source blocker, next operation, or deferred higher-support escape after operation exhaustion.

statement: The current projection taxonomy has no hidden case outside success, no-op, named blocker, next operation, or deferred higher-support escape.
